answers.core: Type inference is deeply integrated into the language's core, affecting the parser, compiler, and possibly the IDE tools. It's not feasible as an add-on because it changes the fundamental way the language is written and understood by the engine.
answers.workaround: Well, yes, if the user types the return type it could be workaround, this is more of a life quality feature.
